title: Signing Envelope
description: Wraps every agent-to-server message after enrolment. The sig field covers all other fields in JCS-canonical form.

device_id.description: Device identifier equal to the serial number of the device certificate.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per device. Starts at 1 after enrolment. Server rejects seq <= last_accepted_seq.

nonce.description: Base64url-encoded 16 cryptographically random bytes. Fresh for each message.

ts_agent.description: Agent wall-clock time at signing, Unix seconds. Advisory; server receive time is authoritative.

payload_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical payload bytes.

prev_hash.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 of the previous envelope (canonical, including sig). For the first message, SHA-256 of the device certificate DER bytes.

payload.description: Message body. Schema is determined by payload_type.

sig.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over the JCS-canonical envelope with this sig field omitted.
